name: copilot-usage-monitor
description: Shows your own Copilot usage, in tokens or estimated USD, as observed in local Copilot session logs on this computer. Side bar summary, a sectioned details panel, month history, trend, per-project and per-tool views, session totals from older Copilot and a personal target range. No credentials read, nothing stored, and no network unless you pick a display currency other than USD (for example CAD, at the daily exchange rate). Not affiliated with GitHub or Microsoft.

walkthroughs.title: Get started with Copilot Usage Monitor (Local)
walkthroughs.description: Check that your Copilot logs are found, pick a unit and currency, set a monthly target and open the side bar. Everything stays on this computer.

steps.title: Check that your Copilot logs are found
steps.description:
The status bar shows a figure when Copilot CLI session logs are found, or "Copilot logs not found" when they are not. If Copilot keeps them elsewhere, set the folder.
[Set the Copilot folder](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%5B%22copilotUsageMonitor.copilotHome%22%5D)

steps.title: Choose tokens or estimated cost, and a currency
steps.description:
Show figures as input + output tokens or as estimated cost. USD needs no network; another currency fetches its daily exchange rate.
[Switch tokens / USD (est.)](command:copilotUsageMonitor.toggleUnit)
[Choose currency](command:copilotUsageMonitor.selectCurrency)

steps.title: Set a monthly target range
steps.description:
Optional: the least and the most estimated cost you mean to use per month, in your currency. The status bar icon then shows under, in range or over.
[Set the target range](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%5B%22copilotUsageMonitor.monthlyTarget%22%5D)

steps.title: Open the side bar and the panel
steps.description:
The side bar gives a compact summary; the panel has the month, sessions, models, projects, tools and data health.
[Open the side bar](command:workbench.view.extension.copilotUsageMonitor)
[Open the panel](command:copilotUsageMonitor.showDetails)

copilotUsageMonitor.copilotHome.description: Folder that contains Copilot's session-state. Empty: use COPILOT_HOME, else ~/.copilot.

copilotUsageMonitor.historyMonths.description: How many months of Copilot session logs to read for the month picker and trend chart, this month included. Older logs are read once at start-up; nothing is stored.

enumDescriptions: Estimated USD: Copilot's logged AI credits × $0.01.
copilotUsageMonitor.display.description: Unit for the status bar and panel figures.

copilotUsageMonitor.panelNavCollapsed.description: Show the details panel's section navigation as a narrow icon rail. The toggle at the top of the navigation sets this.

enumDescriptions: Today's tokens; in the estimated-cost view, this month against your target (the layout before 0.6).
This month so far, in tokens or estimated cost; the target range follows the figure in the cost view.
The current session, in tokens or estimated cost.
copilotUsageMonitor.statusBar.description: What the status bar text shows. The tooltip keeps every figure, and the icon always shows this month's target state.

copilotUsageMonitor.currency.description: Currency for estimated cost. USD needs no network. Any other currency is converted at the daily European Central Bank USD reference rate, fetched from api.frankfurter.dev at start-up and every 6 hours (the request carries only the currency code). Monthly targets are then entered in this currency.

copilotUsageMonitor.monthlyTargetMin.description: Optional personal target: the least estimated cost (in the chosen currency) you want to use per month. Below it, the status bar shows a down arrow.

copilotUsageMonitor.monthlyTargetMax.description: Optional personal target: the most estimated cost (in the chosen currency) you want to use per month. Above it, the status bar turns amber with a flame icon.

copilotUsageMonitor.targetAlert.description: Opt-in: show one notification when this month's estimated cost first goes above monthlyTargetMax (in the chosen currency, once its exchange rate is known). At most once per calendar month per window, remembered in memory only. "Don't show again" turns this setting off. User settings only.

copilotUsageMonitor.projectNames.description: Read each session's start line to label it with a project: the GitHub repository name, else the folder name. A folder named by an ID shows the session title (the name: line of workspace.yaml) instead. Full paths are never kept. Turn off to stop reading both.

copilotUsageMonitor.sessionTotals.description: Count sessions from Copilot before 1.0.99, which have no per-call records, from the per-model total Copilot writes when a session ends. Only the token counts, call count and logged AI credits are kept; file paths and other fields on that line are dropped while reading. Turn off to skip those lines without reading them.
